grammar.label: metadiscourse — telling the reader what the text is doing
grammar.form: This chapter argues…; I turn now to…; The argument so far has been…; What follows is…
grammar.meaning: describes the text itself rather than the subject

explanation.en: Metadiscourse is the writing about the writing. It tells the reader where they are, what has been shown and what is coming. Used well it makes a long argument followable; used heavily it becomes throat-clearing, and a reader who is told three times what is about to be argued starts to suspect it will not be.
explanation.uz: Metadiskurs — matn haqidagi matn. U o'quvchiga qayerdaligini aytadi. Me'yorida bo'lsa uzun dalilni kuzatib borish oson; haddan ortiq bo'lsa, bo'sh gapga aylanadi.

grammar.positive_example: The argument so far has been about cost. I turn now to the question of time.
grammar.negative_example: The argument so far has been about cost. Now I will turn to talk about the next thing, which is time.

l1_notes.uz: Akademik ingliz tilida matn haqida yozish odatiy; o'zbek akademik an'anasida bu kamroq uchraydi.

grammar.label: retrospective labels — this argument, such a view, these objections
grammar.form: determiner + summary noun, referring back to a stretch of text
grammar.meaning: packages a whole previous passage into one noun phrase

explanation.en: After a paragraph of argument, 'this view' or 'these objections' names the whole of it in two words. The choice of noun is an act of interpretation: calling a paragraph 'this claim' is neutral, 'this assumption' is sceptical, 'this evasion' is hostile. The reader takes the label as given, which is why it is such an effective and such an unfair device.
explanation.uz: Bir xatboshi dalildan keyin 'this view' butun qismni ikki so'zda nomlaydi. Ot tanlash — talqin: 'this claim' neytral, 'this assumption' shubhali, 'this evasion' dushmanona.

grammar.positive_example: Two districts refused to supply figures. This silence is itself evidence.
grammar.negative_example: Two districts refused to supply figures. This is itself evidence.

l1_notes.uz: 'This' ni yolg'iz qoldirish o'zbek va rus tillarida odatiy; ingliz akademik yozuvida ot qo'shish talab qilinadi.
